features: [Audio Companion]: Enjoy your favorite shows with the Zeb-Juke bar 9900 which is here to play a key role in indoor entertainment

[Output power]: The exceptional sound quality and outstanding acoustics are primarily attributed to the impressive power output capacity of 725W, with 65W from 3 of the front drivers and 55W from the top 2 drivers, 50W output from each driver of the rear satellites, and 110W output from each of the dual wireless subwoofers.

[Dynamic Audio]: This soundbar has 5 drivers of which 3 are 9x5.8cm and 2 are 5.08cms drivers to stream quality audio. The subwoofer's 16.51cm (6.5”) drivers and quad satellites of driver size 5.8x9 cm each can produce detailed sound.
[Dolby Atmos & DTX]: With its 7.2.2 (5.2.4) CH output and DolbyAtmos, this soundbar is here to provide you with amazing surround sound for streaming music, watching movies, and more

[Multi connectivity]: This sound system allows you to connect various compatible devices to experience detailed audio with its BT v5.3, HDMI eARC, AUX, and Optical Input, and using your USB pen drive of memory up to 32GB
[LED display]: This soundbar's user interface is reinforced with an LED display which displays the operating mode and controls of the speaker
This soundbar can be wall-mounted so, it comes with a wall-mount bracket and a fastener, making your desk space free!
[RGB LED lights]: The colorful RGB LED lights on the soundbar will allow you to light up your living room in hues
[Audio streaming]: A wireless UHF microphone is included
